title: Frontend: Kanban Board
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Kanban Board. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App. Cards A and B start in todo, with doing and done columns. Render column containers[data-column=todo|doing|done], each with cards[data-card=ID]. A Move button[data-move=ID] advances one column, clamped at done. Dragging a card onto a column moves it there exactly once. Render count of cards per column in [data-testid=counts] as todo,doing,done.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Normalize cards by ID and store ordered ID lists per column, or use an equivalent explicit reducer.
alternativeApproaches: Add optimistic server persistence with version conflicts and rollback that preserves newer actions.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Same-column reorder; cross-column move; empty destination.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
